_meta.description: Clarity Theme Registry - Visual styles and prompt modifiers for each theme
_meta.usage: Inject the selected theme's `prompt_injection` into <theme_prompt> placeholder

minimal_dark.name: Minimal Dark
minimal_dark.description: Clean, sophisticated dark theme. Emphasis on whitespace and typography.
minimal_dark.prompt_injection:
## THEME: MINIMAL DARK

### Visual Philosophy
Less is more. Use generous whitespace. Let the content breathe. Dark backgrounds with high-contrast text. Subtle accents, never overwhelming.

### Color Rules
- Background: Use #0a0a0a or #18181b for solid, or gradients between them
- Primary text: #ffffff for headlines, #a1a1aa for body
- Accent: #6366f1 (indigo) for highlights, buttons, accent lines
- Secondary accent: #22c55e (green) for success states, positive metrics
- Use accent colors sparingly - one accent element per 3-4 content elements

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: Inter Bold, 48-96px depending on importance
- Body: Inter Regular, 18-24px
- Keep headlines under 8 words
- Body text max 20 words per block

### Layout Patterns
- Center-align hero content on title slides
- Left-align body content with 60px margin
- Use Rule of Thirds for element placement
- Decorative shapes: circles with 0.1 opacity, positioned at edges

### Animation Style
- Smooth, subtle entrances
- Fade and pop for text, scale for shapes
- Stagger delays: 0.15s between elements
- Never use more than 3 animated elements per slide

### DO
- Use glow orbs (circles, opacity 0.1-0.15) as background decoration
- Add thin accent lines (height: 3-4px) as dividers
- Keep element count low (3-6 per slide)

### DON'T
- Use colors outside the palette
- Add more than 2 accent colors per slide
- Over-animate (keep total delay under 2s)
- Place text below y: 480 (unsafe zone)

minimal_light.name: Minimal Light
minimal_light.description: Clean, airy light theme. Perfect for corporate and educational content.
minimal_light.prompt_injection:
## THEME: MINIMAL LIGHT

### Visual Philosophy
Bright, clean, trustworthy. Ample whitespace. Soft shadows over hard borders. Professional without being sterile.

### Color Rules
- Background: #ffffff or #f4f4f5
- Primary text: #18181b for headlines, #52525b for body
- Accent: #2563eb (blue) for primary actions and highlights
- Use soft gray (#e4e4e7) for card backgrounds and dividers
- Shadows instead of borders for depth

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: Inter SemiBold, 44-80px
- Body: Inter Regular, 18-22px
- Slightly larger margins than dark themes (80px sides)
- More line height (1.6) for readability

### Layout Patterns
- Generous top margins (60px+)
- Cards with subtle shadows (no borders)
- Content islands - group related elements in subtle containers
- Accent lines under headings, not above

### Animation Style
- Slide animations preferred over pop
- Shorter durations (0.5-0.7s)
- Direction: up or right for positive content
- Minimal decoration animation

### DO
- Use subtle shadows for depth (rgba(0,0,0,0.08))
- Add thin accent underlines to headlines
-Keep backgrounds simple (solid or very subtle gradients)

### DON'T
- Use dark backgrounds
- Add glow effects (those are for dark themes)
- Use saturated colors for large areas
- Create low-contrast text situations

neon_cyberpunk.name: Neon Cyberpunk
neon_cyberpunk.description: Bold, futuristic with vibrant neon accents. High energy, high contrast.
neon_cyberpunk.prompt_injection:
## THEME: NEON CYBERPUNK

### Visual Philosophy
Bold, electric, futuristic. Neon colors pop against deep purple-black backgrounds. Glows, gradients, and geometric shapes. Think Blade Runner meets modern UI.

### Color Rules
- Background: Deep purple-blacks (#0f0f23, #1a0a2e)
- Primary accents: Hot pink (#f0abfc), Cyan (#22d3ee), Lime (#a3e635)
- Text: Pure white or soft purple (#c4b5fd)
- Use gradients freely for backgrounds
- Glow effects on accent elements (0.2-0.3 opacity)

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: Outfit Bold, 52-100px - make them BIG
- Body: Inter Regular, 18-24px
- Headlines can be ALL CAPS for impact
- Use accent colors for headline text

### Layout Patterns
- Asymmetric layouts work well
- Geometric decorations (circles, angled lines)
- Glowing orbs as background elements (opacity 0.2-0.3)
- Grid patterns for tech feel

### Animation Style
- Pop and scale for impact
- Faster animations (0.4-0.6s)
- More elements can animate (4-5 per slide)
- Sequential reveals work great

### DO
- Use multiple accent colors (2-3 per slide is fine)
- Add glowing shapes as decoration
- Use gradient backgrounds
- Go bold with typography size
- Add tech-inspired grid patterns

### DON'T
- Use muted or pastel colors
- Make things look corporate or safe
- Use light backgrounds
- Under-animate (this theme wants energy)

nature_organic.name: Nature Organic
nature_organic.description: Earthy, warm, natural tones. Perfect for sustainability, wellness, and lifestyle.
nature_organic.prompt_injection:
## THEME: NATURE ORGANIC

### Visual Philosophy
Warm, inviting, natural. Soft curves replace sharp corners. Earth tones with pops of green. Feels like a breath of fresh air.

### Color Rules
- Backgrounds: Warm creams (#fefce8), soft greens (#f0fdf4)
- Text: Warm darks (#1c1917, #44403c) - never pure black
- Primary accent: Forest green (#16a34a)
- Secondary: Goldenrod (#ca8a04), Teal (#0d9488)
- Gradients should be subtle, between similar warm tones

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: Outfit Medium, 40-72px - friendly, not aggressive
- Body: Inter Regular, 18-22px
- Higher line height (1.7) for calm reading
- Never use ALL CAPS - feels too aggressive

### Layout Patterns
- Generous whitespace (margin: 80px)
- Rounded corners everywhere (24px+)
- Organic shapes as decorations (blob-like circles)
- Image-heavy layouts work well

### Animation Style
- Slow, gentle fades (0.8-1.2s)
- Longer stagger delays (0.2s)
- Scale animations for growth metaphor
- Avoid sharp, punchy animations

### DO
- Use natural image backgrounds when possible
- Round all corners generously
- Include nature imagery (plants, water, sky)
- Keep contrast lower than dark themes
- Use soft shadows

### DON'T
- Use neon or electric colors
- Make sharp corners or hard edges
- Use pure black or white
- Create high-energy, aggressive layouts

corporate_modern.name: Corporate Modern
corporate_modern.description: Professional, trustworthy, structured. Ideal for business, finance, and enterprise.
corporate_modern.prompt_injection:
## THEME: CORPORATE MODERN

### Visual Philosophy
Trust, clarity, competence. Structured layouts, data-driven visuals, conservative color usage. Every element has purpose.

### Color Rules
- Backgrounds: Dark blues (#0f172a, #1e293b)
- Text: Off-white (#f8fafc) for headlines, light gray (#cbd5e1) for body
- Primary accent: Corporate blue (#3b82f6)
- Use success green for positive metrics, error red sparingly
- Never use more than 2 accent colors per slide

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: Inter SemiBold, 36-64px - clear, not flashy
- Body: Inter Regular, 16-20px
- Data should be prominently sized
- Labels slightly smaller than body text

### Layout Patterns
- Grid-based, structured layouts
- Charts and data visualizations should be prominent
- Left-aligned content for readability
- Cards with subtle borders (#334155)
- Clean separation between sections

### Animation Style
- Professional slide-ins (left to right)
- Shorter durations (0.4-0.6s)
- Minimal animation per slide (2-3 elements)
- No playful or bouncy animations

### DO
- Use charts and data prominently
- Create clear visual hierarchy
- Add subtle borders to cards
- Use icons to support text
- Keep layouts symmetrical

### DON'T
- Use playful animations or decorations
- Add unnecessary ornamental shapes
- Use creative/artistic layouts
- Break the grid structure

gradient_sunset.name: Gradient Sunset
gradient_sunset.description: Warm, vibrant gradients with orange and pink tones. Creative and bold.
gradient_sunset.prompt_injection:
## THEME: GRADIENT SUNSET

### Visual Philosophy
Bold, warm, memorable. Gradients are the star. Orange-to-pink-to-purple creates visual journey. Dark backgrounds make gradients pop.

### Color Rules
- Backgrounds: Dark (#18181b) to let gradients shine
- Gradient elements: Orange (#f97316) → Pink (#db2777) → Purple (#7c3aed)
- Text: Pure white on dark, can use gradient colors for headlines
- Use gradients for: buttons, accent shapes, headline backgrounds

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: Outfit Bold, 44-88px
- Body: Inter Regular, 18-22px
- Headlines can use gradient backgrounds with text on top
- Warm colors (#fda4af, #fb7185) for secondary text

### Layout Patterns
- Asymmetric layouts encouraged
- Large gradient shapes as decoration
- Cards with gradient borders or backgrounds
- Hero content can span full width

### Animation Style
- Scale and pop for impactful reveals
- Medium speed (0.6-0.8s)
- More elements can animate (4-5)
- Stagger for rhythm

### DO
- Use gradient backgrounds on shapes
- Create large, bold headlines
- Layer multiple gradient elements
- Use warm tones throughout
- Add glow effects (0.2-0.3 opacity)

### DON'T
- Use cold colors (blue, green) as primary
- Make gradients too subtle
- Use light backgrounds
- Keep things too minimal - this theme wants presence

retro_bit.name: Retro 8-Bit
retro_bit.description: Minecraft-inspired voxel aesthetics. Blocky fonts, high contrast, vibrant primitive colors.
retro_bit.prompt_injection:
## THEME: RETRO 8-BIT

### Visual Philosophy
Think blocks. Voxel art. Minecraft. Hard edges, no curves. Everything snaps to a grid. Vibrant, primitive colors against dirt and grass tones.

### Color Rules
- Backgrounds: Dark Dirt Brown (#3e2723) or Deep Grass Green (#182813)
- Accents: Diamond Blue (#48d0b0), Gold Ingot Yellow (#e2a939), Emerald Green (#5a9e2f)
- Text: White pixel text. Use Green (#a5d6a7) for secondary text.
- High contrast is key.

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: 'Press Start 2P', 16-48px (Keep it smaller, this font is wide)
- Body: 'VT323', 20-24px (scrolling terminal style)
- IMPORTANT: 'Press Start 2P' only sustains weight 400. NEVER use 'bold'. Always use fontWeight: 'normal'.
- Text should look like chat logs or item labels.

### Layout Patterns
- STRICT GRID. Align everything perfectly.
- Containers MUST have 0px border radius.
- Use thick borders (4px+) for cards.
- Shadows should be solid (no blur) and offset by 4-8px.

### Animation Style
- Instant appearances or quick pops (0.3-0.4s).
- No smooth fades. Things should 'chunk' into existence.
- Stagger elements quickly.

### DO
- Use square/rectangular shapes exclusively.
- Mention 'blocks', 'chunks', 'crafting', 'mining' in visual descriptions.
- Use 4px solid borders.
- Center hero text like a game title screen.

### DON'T
- Use rounded corners (borderRadius: 0 always).
- Use smooth gradients.
- Use thin, elegant fonts.
- Make animations slow and floaty.

manga_pop.name: Manga Pop
manga_pop.description: High-energy Japanese comic style. Dramatic angles, speed lines, black & white with punchy accents.
manga_pop.prompt_injection:
## THEME: MANGA POP

### Visual Philosophy
High impact. Comic book panels. Asymmetry. Action lines. Think 'Akira' meets modern web design. Black and white base with intensely vibrant red/yellow accents.

### Color Rules
- Backgrounds: Mostly White (#ffffff) or Jet Black (#171717).
- Accents: Hero Red (#dc2626) and Action Yellow (#fcd34d).
- Text: Black on White, White on Black. Huge contrast.

### Typography Rules
- Headlines: 'Bebas Neue'. HUGE. Uppercase only. Tilted or overlapping.
- Body: 'Lato' or 'Roboto'. Clean, legible inside bubbles.
- Use text as texture (e.g. giant '01' in background).

### Layout Patterns
- COMIC PANELS. Use thick black borders (6px+) to frame content.
- Overlap elements wildly. Break the grid.
- Speech bubbles for key text.
- 'Speed lines' or diagonal slices.

### Animation Style
- FAST. 0.3s max for entrances.
- Slide in from wild angles (corners).
- Scale punches (bam!).

### DO
- Use black borders on everything.
- Tilt images or text slightly (rotation).
- Use 'halftone' dots if possible.
- Make it feel like a page turn.

### DON'T
- Be subtle.
- Use pastel colors.
- Center align everything (prefer asymmetry).
- Use slow fades.
